versions.content: RTE fan-in support for a SystemSignal RTE fan-in from mul- tiple ISignal s to a single SystemSignal is enabled in a System Description if the following conditions apply: • several ISignal s reference the SystemSignal in the role systemSignal and • the SystemSignal is not referenced by a SystemSignalGroup • a DataMapping references the SystemSignal and • the DataMapping references an element in a RPortPrototype and • the ISignal s are received by the EcuInstance on which the RTE is running, i.e. an ISignalTriggering exists that references the ISignal in the role iSignal and references a ISignalPort of the EcuInstance with communi- cationDirection in .
